list: the official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them
note: Names and descriptions are the official PlayStation text. Guides are written in our own words for this entry; each guide names its sources. Facts the official description does not state are marked as not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then activities, then collectibles and grind, then cleanup — and this trophy closes the set. Track it here: when the counter reads 54 of 55, the platinum is the only one left.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end. It is the first story mission, so this is normally the first trophy most players earn and it cannot be skipped. If it has not popped, check the mission is fully finished — including any closing cutscene or objective — rather than abandoned midway.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission is complete, so keep playing the story in order and do not worry about side content yet. Chapter progress is tracked in the game's story menu, which shows which missions of the chapter remain.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2, in story order. Like the other chapter trophies, it pops at the end of the chapter's last mission. Side activities and collectibles can wait until after the story; the chapter trophy only needs the story missions done.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. This is the midpoint chapter trophy: by now the map and the game's systems are fully open, but the trophy itself still only asks for the story missions. If a mission is giving trouble, retry it from the pause menu rather than restarting the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter before the finale. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. After it, only the final mission stands between you and the gold story trophy, so keep a save from before the finale if you want to revisit choices later.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game's final mission to earn this gold trophy. It marks the end of the story, so finish the four chapter trophies first and arrive at the finale with a manual save made beforehand. After the credits, free roam continues, so missed side content can still be cleaned up afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named mission trophies like this one pop as soon as that mission is finished, in story order — there is no extra objective to chase. If you are past it in the story and the trophy is missing, the mission was not the one named here.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions usually have a setup phase before the job itself, so make sure the whole mission chain is finished, not just the setup. The trophy pops at the end of the heist mission itself.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, it only needs that one mission finished in story order. Keep playing the story and it will come on its own turn.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The trophy is tied to that mission alone, so no side objective or collectible is needed. Finish the mission and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The name points at the airport (VCIA), so expect the mission to take place around it, but the trophy only asks that the mission be completed. Finish it in story order and move on.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. This is one of the later named-mission trophies, so it comes naturally near the end of the story. Complete the mission and the trophy pops; nothing else is required for it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own completion checklist, shown in the stats menu. This is a late-game gold: it wraps up the story, the side strands, the activities and the collectibles that count toward completion. Use this tracker to clear the other trophies first, then check the in-game completion percentage to see exactly which category is still short.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total — jumps, near misses, airtime and similar driving feats, counted cumulatively across free roam and missions. There is no single place to farm them: drive fast, take jumps and ramps, and let the counter climb naturally while you travel. The in-game stats screen tracks the stunt total, so check it there before grinding the last few.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — one go at each is enough, no win or score needed. The activity types are the ones this guide lists under Activities (races, fishing, arcade, shooting range, drone races, meditation, hunting, bowling and stunts). Work through them one by one early, while the map is still fresh, and tick each off here as you try it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own gold target score or time, shown at the range before you start, so read it first and pick the right weapon for the drill. Replay a challenge as often as needed — medals are per challenge, and the trophy only pops once all 42 are gold. Do the easy ones first to learn the scoring, then return for the hard ones.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is a separate race, so you must win at every one — winning the same location twice does not help. Learn each course's line on a practice run, then race to win; the drone handles differently from a car, so take the first attempt at each location slowly to learn the gates.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Races include the driving races found around Leonida and the Top Fun drone races; spread your wins across the race list. A race you have already won does not count again, so keep a note of which ones you have won and move to new events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: land the better catch or the higher score in the challenge's rules, shown when the challenge starts. Take the challenge when it appears, read the win condition first, and focus on steady reeling rather than rushing. If you lose, the challenge can be tried again.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade machine, any title. You do not need a high score or a win, just a completed playthrough of the game. Arcades are found around Vice City; pick the shortest game first if you only want the trophy quickly.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy is one of the stranger contacts whose mission strand runs beside the main story: follow his missions in order until the strand ends. The trophy pops at the end of his last mission, so no extra objective is needed beyond finishing the strand.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Follow Kenton's strand of missions in order until it ends; the trophy pops at his last mission. Like the other contact strands, it is separate from the main chapters, so check the map for his marker if the strand seems stalled.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Work through Billy's mission strand in order; the trophy pops when his last mission is done. If the next mission does not appear, keep playing the main story — some strands only unlock after story progress.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The named contacts in this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are part of that set, so their final-mission trophies count toward this silver as well. A strand only counts when its last mission is done, so finish strands completely instead of starting many and finishing none. Stranger markers appear on the map as you explore.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Follow Randy's strand in order to its end; the trophy pops at his last mission. If the strand stalls, advance the main story — later stranger missions often unlock only after story progress.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Work through Tyrone's strand in order until its last mission is done. The trophy pops at the end of that mission, and it counts as one of the 8 strands for the Strangers & Freaks silver.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Each spot counts once, so you need to visit every one — revisiting a spot you already used does not add to the count. Spots are scenic viewpoints; explore the map systematically, region by region, and use the in-game tracker to see how many spots remain.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand asks for one specific animal — follow his instructions to find where it lives, track it, and take it down. Bring a suitable weapon and approach quietly; a unique animal is a one-off hunt, so a failed attempt may need the hunt to be restarted from its start.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are found scattered across Leonida; a set only counts when every card in it is collected. Collect cards as you travel rather than leaving them all to the end, and keep a checklist of which sets are finished — this tracker cannot see your in-game card count, so note finished sets in the guide text of this entry as you go.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It interaction at 100 different locations. Each location counts once, so spread it out: use it at new places as you explore rather than repeating the same spot. This is a long grind — fold it into the exploration trophy (The Goodtime State, 52 areas) and the meditation spots, so the same travel earns progress on several trophies at once.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total, counted across all challenge types in the game. Challenges are the small objectives the game lists in its challenge menu; easy ones (first-time activities, simple driving or combat goals) count the same as hard ones, so clear the easy ones first. Check the challenge menu regularly to see which ones are close to done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Both characters must be together for it to count, so start it during a moment when your partner is with you in free roam. Once the wanted level is at 4 stars, break line of sight, get out of the search area, and stay hidden until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route of three close shops first, then rob them one after another and keep moving — do not stop to fight the police, or the chain breaks. If the wanted level clears before the third robbery, the run does not count and you start the chain again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts when you first enter or drive a model you have not used before, so variety matters more than distance: try every new car, bike, boat and aircraft you pass. Parking lots, traffic in different districts and mission vehicles are the fastest way to meet new models. Check the in-game vehicle list for how many remain.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with at least five enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends. A busy shootout or a mission with grouped enemies is the best chance; in open free roam, gather attention first, then activate it when the group is in range.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA airport — leave by aircraft without a scheduled flight. Get a plane or helicopter at the airport and take off; the trophy is about the departure itself, not about where you land. Expect a wanted level on the way in, so go in with a fast vehicle and head straight for an aircraft.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This trophy is about the Rhino tank: the description hints at getting into one. Raise a high wanted level so the military responds, or find a Rhino where the army deploys it, and get inside one. The exact trigger is not stated in the official description, so treat this as unverified in-game: try entering a Rhino first, and if it does not pop, surviving in one under fire is the next thing to try.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and sightlines, take what you came for, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, let the heat die down, and try again. A night attempt with a quiet approach is the safest plan.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is a separate robbery: get in, take the money, and escape the wanted level before it counts. Plan an escape route before you enter, keep a fast vehicle nearby, and do not linger. Vaults are spread across Leonida, so this pairs well with the exploration trophy.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Armored trucks travel set routes around the city — spot one, stop it, take the money, and escape the wanted level that follows. Hit it on a quiet stretch of road so you can get away cleanly, and have a fast getaway vehicle ready before you strike.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. An area counts when you have visited it, so the job is systematic travel: work through the map region by region — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the countryside — and cover the edges of each area, not just its centre. Pair this with the WAiNK locations, meditation spots and card hunting so one trip covers several trophies.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang's operation is a separate target, so you must hit all nine — robbing the same gang twice does not help. Illegal operations are marked as you discover gang territory; work through them gang by gang and note which ones you have done. Expect a fight at each one, and an escape afterwards.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do this early. Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a one-time early moment: head to Ocean Beach, find the spot with the view, and have the cocktail there. Because the moment can pass, do it as soon as the game lets you roam freely, before pushing far into the story. If you are already deep into the story and have not done it, check whether the moment is still available before assuming it is lost.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom's glass front and out onto the street. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or aimed at it, and drive out through the glass. The trophy is about the exit itself, so the crash is the point: do it in one clean run.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — finish a game there. You do not need a particular score, just a completed game at that specific alley. Head to the Kolt & Associates alley, start a game, and play it to the end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description gives no concrete step, only that it is about a partnership with mass appeal — so no specific location or action is claimed here. In practice this reads like a story or partner moment that arrives as the partnership grows; keep playing the story and the partner activities, and check the trophy's progress on PlayStation, which tracks a count for some trophies. Marked as not yet verified in-game: do not chase a specific spot for this one until a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — choices matter. The description is deliberately vague, and PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 for this trophy, so it is about the choices you make across the game adding up. Make choices whenever the game offers them — dialogue choices, approach choices, story decisions — instead of always taking the same path, and keep a save before major decisions so you can revisit a choice that went the wrong way. Do not assume one single choice earns it: the count suggests it builds up over many decisions.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — succeed on a second try. The description means what it says: fail something once, then succeed at it on the second attempt. The safest reading is a mission or challenge you fail and then pass on the retry — so if you fail a mission early, do not reload an old save to erase the failure; retry it and finish it. Which attempts count is not stated in the official description, so treat the exact trigger as not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — this is the game's odd-event trophy. The description gives no location, so no specific spot is claimed here: strange events in this series are usually found by exploring unusual places at unusual times. Roam the remoter corners of Leonida, especially at night, and pay attention to anything out of the ordinary. Marked as not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — hit a person with a melee attack while driving past in a vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing the melee attack as you pass, and connect. Pick a quiet street so you can line the pass up without traffic in the way, and expect a wanted level afterwards.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 in total by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to a contact who launders them and the clean money counts toward the $250,000. Keep laundering after every big job instead of letting bills pile up, and the total builds steadily across the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles, food and anything else the shops sell. The total is cumulative and counts every shop, so normal spending across the game adds up. Late in the game, if you are short, buy expensive items you actually want (a vehicle or a weapon) rather than wasting money on things you will never use.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are bought from property listings; each one costs money, so save up and buy them as you can afford them. They also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for the Whip It Good trophy, so buy them as you explore new areas.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the app on your in-game phone to register vehicles you own or find — each new registration counts once. Register vehicles as you discover them for the Whip It Good trophy, so the two trophies progress together.
